title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Auditorio Nacional, Mexico City | 2013
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Auditorio Nacional (National Auditorium) in Mexico City, Mexico, on 19 November 2013.

It was the 26th show of the 12th All-Starr Band’s 2013 tour, which lasted for 28 dates between February and November, and the last of three shows in Mexico City.

Starr had previously performed at the Auditorio Nacional on 1 November 2011. He returned there on 10 March 2015 and 5 and 6 June 2024.

The 12th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, keyboards
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, organ, keyboards
  • Todd Rundgren: vocals, guitar, harmonica, bass, percussion, keyboards
  • Richard Page: vocals, bass guitar, acoustic guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, percussion
